svg.text: HARDWARE LIBRARY - CATALOGUE, EDITOR AND APPROVAL

g.text: 1. US-001 Adding hardware not in the catalogue
Create a type with manufacturer, model, planes and port layout.
Search, filter by category, plane and origin. Your own types stay visible.
All 131 types carry across unchanged, each recording its planes.
Edit any type. Restore returns the shipped definition.
A layout beyond the limit is rejected, and the limit is stated.
Refused, naming the plans. Deleting your own types is allowed.
Markable as approved. Enforcement is deferred pending a threat model.
Searchable without loading it all. An interrupted write cannot damage it.
